proposed.sourceName: JAKIM e-SMAF — Muzakarah Jawatankuasa Fatwa MKI, 'Hukum Mengenai Stunning Haiwan' (2005)
proposed.paraphrase: Malaysia's National Fatwa Committee regime published by JAKIM (captive-bolt prohibited; only non-lethal, head-only electrical stunning under accredited Muslim supervision; Islamic slaughter throughout) comfortably exceeds the lenient bar, which requires only lawful slaughter and halal ingredients.
